protocol.fees: User approved standard assumptions: maker 2 bps, taker 5 bps per fill; no discounts
protocol.selection: Maximum worst-development-fold net P&L; name tie break. All three validation rows shown, never used to reselect.
protocol.gate: Selected candidate: each dev fold >=10 trades and net>0; validation >=30 trades, net>0, PF>=1.15, daily bootstrap lower95>0, same-trade doubled-cost net>0
protocol.fill_model: Market taker/taker, 4 bps spread, 2 bps per-side slippage, actual funding; stop-first intrabar ties. No maker fills simulated.
protocol.evidence: Retrospective independent market interval, not a forward trial or a replication of published profitability

uncertainty.method: IID resampling of whole UTC days, preserving within-day trade correlation; few days limits confidence

same_trade_stress.method: Same positions, size and exit timestamps; double fees/adverse slippage. Not a replay of changed stops or liquidity.
